A Refined Journey Through Vietnamese Cuisine and Creativity
Aug 2025 • Friends
From the moment we stepped into Nén Light, we knew we were in for something special. The ambiance was elegant yet welcoming, with a calm, refined atmosphere that set the tone for the evening.

Each course was a stunning expression of modern Vietnamese cuisine - innovative and creative, yet using all traditional ingredients. The staff were attentive and knowledgeable, taking the time to explain the inspiration and ingredients behind each dish, which made the experience even more memorable.

Nén Light isn’t just dinner - it’s a beautifully crafted experience. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to explore Vietnam through taste, story, and craftsmanship.

A hidden gem in Saigon ! 
We were recommended Nen Light by a friend and decided to try it on our second night in Ho Chi Minh City — and we’re so glad we did. From the moment we stepped in, the vibe was calm and intimate, unlike the usual hustle and bustle in the city.
The tasting menu was impressive — not just delicious, but also full of stories. The chef clearly puts a lot of thought into connecting traditional Vietnamese ingredients with modern techniques. Each course was unique and beautifully plated.
Service was excellent — very warm and attentive without being too formal. They explained everything in perfect English, which we appreciated.
If you're a foodie visiting Saigon and want to try something refined, local, and different from the usual pho and banh mi — this is 100% worth it.

Nov 2024 • Couples
Amazing birthday treat with my wife. Tucked away in an oasis of calm found delicious found served with a story. Not sure where to start when describing this extremely disappointing dinning experience. The restaurant theme is the life experiences of the chef mirrored into food, however the waiter could not speak proper english, thus it was impossible to understand the experience. 
Besides one good dish, the other 8 were very basic, underwhelming and tinny. The drinks paired with food were bad and the top of the cheery was a donut served as a dessert. All this for almost 400 USD for 2 person in Vietnam!! Do not go here, it is a rip off, very unpleasant one.

Worthy of your last meal on earth
Apr 2023 • Couples
If I were to have my last meal on earth, I'd ask Chef Summer to compose it. That's how much I loved this experience! I was skeptical of the storytelling concept at first. But the poetry of dishes named "Storm Born" and "Danang Sky" and the visual artistry of the pairings with ceramic dishes that echoed the narrative theme, got me taking pictures. Not good ones cause my husband kept on eating the dishes immediately. Which brings me to the food. Normally, haute cuisine means too much cleverness with pairing unlikely ingredients and teasing them into unrecognizable compositions. In this case, the dishes were umami bombs that went off in my mouth. My fave was The Paper, which had layers of grilled eel and duck pate layered between a smoky thin wafer of a vegetable called Mong Toi. I upgraded from the 7 course to the 9 course menu after that course. Only thing that could have improved it were slightly larger portions. We left satiated but not full, and definitely wanting to come back for more.

Wow! Just WOW!
Aug 2022 • Solo
Wow, just wow! While I have dined many times at the Nen in Da Nang, and so I was naturally expecting Nen Light to be fabulous, my expectations were not just met but far exceeded. Leon and Summer Le are so talented in every aspect of creating a truly memorable experience. All the cues are wonderful. The restaurant itself is beautiful. The staff is so fantastic. The food is not only crazy wonderful just to look at, but equally as stunning in taste. I had the 9 course menu and with wine pairing. Portions are spot on and the wine paring was just incredible. Also they have a nice and fun way to engage with you, as you get to choose from 3 different types, and I choose “Eager” which was wonderful since I like to hear all about how each dish is prepared. So if you want a truly memorable experience then Nen Light is a must try. I can’t wait to go back again. When you go ask for Crystal as she is so amazing and knowledgeable. Of course I am confident all the staff is as incredible.
